title: Taiwanese American Student Association at UC San Diego
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at the University of California, San Diego is a registered student organization that provides a community for Taiwanese Americans and those interested in Taiwanese culture. The organization is listed in the UCSD Center for Student Involvement’s official student org directory and maintains an active constitution last revised in September 2024.

TASA’s stated purpose centers on cultural awareness and community-building. As described in its UCSD directory listing, the organization recognizes that “the Taiwanese-American identity is one that is very diverse and at times, divisive,” and works to unify individuals across that spectrum through social, cultural, and service activities held throughout the academic year. Per its 2024–2025 constitution, TASA meets no less than twice per month and hosts events open to all students interested in Taiwanese American culture. The organization also cultivates connections beyond UCSD, describing itself as creating “a culture of unity within San Diego and extends across universities.”

TASA maintains an active Instagram presence at @tasa.atucsd, a Facebook page, and a Linktree hub for the 2024–2025 academic year.
